Vikram Nair
vikram.nair.ops@gmail.com | +91 97450 88123 | Bengaluru, Karnataka
Operations professional who has spent the last 6 years keeping supply chains running on time across two logistics companies.
Inventory management, vendor negotiation, SAP ERP, warehouse management systems, Excel, Power BI, team leadership, process improvement.
Operations Lead at Swiftline Logistics, Bengaluru, from March 2021 to present. Reduced average delivery delays by 22% across 4 regional hubs. Managed a team of 12 warehouse staff and 3 shift supervisors. Introduced a new vendor scorecard system that cut late deliveries from vendors by a third.
Warehouse Supervisor at Metro Freight Solutions, Chennai, from June 2018 to February 2021. Supervised daily operations for a 40,000 sq ft warehouse. Coordinated with 15+ vendors on inbound shipment schedules. Trained new warehouse staff on safety protocols and inventory systems.
B.Com from Madras University, completed in 2018. Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Management from a private institute, completed in 2019.
Six Sigma Green Belt certified in 2022. Completed an SAP ERP fundamentals course in 2020.
